title: Wire up the main screen
prompt: Complete Pocket Budget's main screen. Tapping a row must push `ExpenseDetail` for that expense using value-based navigation, and the plus button must present `AddExpenseView` modally while `isAdding` is true.
hints: A value-based link names the value it carries with an argument label.
The modifier that maps a value type to a destination screen has "navigation" in its name and takes `for:`.
The modifier that presents a modal card over the current screen has a one-word name.
